images.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create one photorealistic premium e-commerce garment photograph for fictional technical-apparel brand FORM/TECH. Product: Halo Cropped Shell, a distinctly women's cropped boxy technical jacket with a gently shaped waist, generous sculpted hood, full dark central front zip, long articulated raglan sleeves, adjustable cuff tabs, two angled zipped side pockets, subtly curved cropped hip-length hem. Main fabric SILVER (#BFC4C8), dark graphite zipper pulls and hardware. Show one entire empty garment in a straight-on front view using invisible ghost mannequin styling, no body, no visible mannequin, no hanger. Match a restrained architectural technical fashion catalog: pale cool grey (#ECEEF0) seamless studio background, soft diffused light, realistic matte lightly crinkled woven fabric, delicate contact shadow. Portrait 4:5 composition, garment centered, evenly framed with 8-12 percent empty margin, premium sharp stitching and construction detail. No text, branding, logos, props, collage, inset, human, extra garment or accessories. Output a high-quality PNG product image.
